current.text: Mark Williams is out long term with a torn labrum. One note gives 5 to 6 months.
Experts expect him to share center minutes with Maluach, often as a small-ball five. Maluach looks more likely to start, and Phoenix wants its top 10 pick in the starting spot.
He put up big numbers at the end of last season while Williams had a foot issue.
He would need about 35 minutes with no competition to matter in 12-team leagues.

durable.text: He is not a good fantasy player because his usage is very low.
He has no shooting range beyond five feet. He is a smart passer, can put the ball on the floor and is a very underrated defender.
He makes no threes and his FT% is very poor. Both are clear weak categories.

tags.name: FT% liability
tags.detail: Projected FT% under 50 on about 1.5 attempts per game

note: He is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 170), ESPN at 1 USD (rank 122), and nobody drafted him in our league last season. Low usage, no threes and a sub-50 FT% leave him with only FG% and some steals and assists. Early in the season, check whether Maluach starts and whether his minutes get close to the 27.6 ESPN projects. If they do, he is a cheap FAB add.
